snippet.title: Conversational Korean
snippet.description:
If you're new to this channel, then here are some information for you.

If you're beginner who is willing to learn Korean, then I suggest you to learn 한글 the Korean Alphabet first, which is interestingly unique and easy to learn.
(Let's Learn 한글 - The Korean Alphabet: https://youtu.be/zO5vfF8ZrOA)

After you learn 한글, then you can practice reading with simple words with this video called "Korean Reading (and Pronunciation) Practice" (https://youtu.be/WqGfsp2EY9U)

And here is the playlist for beginner to learn some about Korean grammar.
Easy Korean Lessons by Suntae Kim (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLuLlpUiq3ndhd5h7xTq_QBEIw9cWMAd6g)

I hope you enjoy your study!
Thank you!
